IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, wavy light brown
hair wears an oversized dark green varsity jacket with
brown leather sleeves and an embroidered patch, over
a cream ribbed top with a loose bow at the neck. A
pleated denim mini skirt and a soft, sunny backdrop
complete the look. Her expression is calm and direct.
Warm, natural light. Palette of forest green, chocolate,
and denim blue. Retro and collegiate, in the style of a
1990s street-style photo.
Retro, collegiate, cozy
WORKING NOTES
- The leather sleeves and bow collar are the defining
details.
- Keep the patch unbranded to avoid text in the image.
